Open source LLMs are on fire right now, GLM 5.3 especially: three times fewer parameters than Kimi K3 and it still comes out ahead. Could not resist finding out what that does in 3D.

🔹 Try Fish Audio's API / MCP: https://fish.audio/?fpr=stefan3d
Newest S2.1 Pro is free through November, no hard cap, same model people pay for.

Ten hard briefs across Blender, Unity and Godot, with Qwen 3.8 Max along for the same ten because that one is a curious model in its own right. Honestly impressed by both, they build real things. Reliability is where it falls apart, so I put Grok 4.6 in as the paid one this round to see what paying still buys you. Strong models, nuances and all.
